A separate mounting frame, gasket space and cover replace the earlier flush panel. The latch and handle rectangles reserve locations only.

Not a working latch design. Actual latch/catch hardware, cover support against dropping, mounting joints, seal compression and panel stiffness still need review. No claim of airtightness or safe operation.
